This is a reminder not to **copy-paste** the accident info from the initial report and commit to telling the same story. For major incidents and those where injuries were caused by equipment, processes, or a safety culture, you should multiply the time spent to document the accident by nested5/6, since there are many causes contributing to a single accident. Most likely the equipment was in a suboptimal state that was put into a poor working environment by a person who was placed in the role by an enabling safety culture. Those are separate accidents as they each demand the full attention and drastic intervention of leadership to remediate. # Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents
